### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **292** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**67** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c5361e2c701bab0cd4c196d31ea8549dd3221ac5`.

⛔ **19** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 49 pages)`, `snake_case (literal, 52 pages)`
- **33** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **64** of **227** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **163** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **163**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c5361e2c701bab0cd4c196d31ea8549dd3221ac5` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `72adcb843224f56013986a2c2fab527d287d9add` — the merge of head `e855b1444c835356aa51c46efd1d8b60d63ae722` into base `c5361e2c701bab0cd4c196d31ea8549dd3221ac5`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 72adcb843224f56013986a2c2fab527d287d9add && git checkout 72adcb843224f56013986a2c2fab527d287d9add
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin c5361e2c701bab0cd4c196d31ea8549dd3221ac5 e855b1444c835356aa51c46efd1d8b60d63ae722 && git checkout -B drift-repro c5361e2c701bab0cd4c196d31ea8549dd3221ac5 && git merge --no-ff e855b1444c835356aa51c46efd1d8b60d63ae722

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json c5361e2c701bab0cd4c196d31ea8549dd3221ac5
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs c5361e2c701bab0cd4c196d31ea8549dd3221ac5` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review — ACCEPT

Head-sha: `e56cfa3291f9b0e6394b0f4f91b6cc7213f90884`

**席位意见：ACCEPT · 默认档，席位自审 · 2026-11-08T17:04Z**。本 PR 不碰任何契约面：`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none`，没有 `packages/spec/src`，也没有 governed 文本。按 pt-BR（#31440）、ru（#31466）、de（#31511，ACCEPT 6722209377）的先例，由席位在默认档自审。PR 有 7331 行（其中生成包占大头），超过 3000 行门槛，按 Tier H 走人工合并。

## 席位核对

- **形态：** draft，目标 `main`。首行 `Fixes #30512`，ko 是 #30512 剩下的最后一个语言，合并后关闭这张卡。正文带 `Thread-read: 6723260365`。
- **覆盖：** 36 个文件，与 #31511 逐文件对齐，包括：
  - ko 的两份生成包（objects 1704 个叶子、metadata-forms 1263 个叶子）和出处表，手写 `ko.ts`（141 个叶子）与它的摘要表；
  - 抽取配置、注册行；
  - 三处内嵌映射：`sys-user.page.ts`、`sys-organization.page.ts`、`system.datasets.ts` 的空值标签；
  - de 加过的各测试语言列表。

  席位读了三处内嵌映射的 diff：每行只是在 `de` 后面追加一个 `ko`，已有语言一个字节都没变。
- **抽读译文：** `구성원`、`초대`、`팀`、`세부 정보`、`계정 상태`、`감사`、`직위`、`권한 세트`、`사업부`、`이메일 미인증`、`인증 이메일 다시 보내기`、`클라우드 연결`、`대기열 구성원`、`액세스 정책`、`사용자 경험`、`로그인 이벤트`。卡上要求钉住的导航项都在：`내 승인 대기`、`배정 규칙`、`AI 어시스턴트`。用语与已有 ko 插件包一致（합니다 体，`상사` 与 `관리자` 分开，`사업부`/`부서` 按 `bu-rename-consistency` 区分）。
- **与 `en` 字节相同的叶子：** 45 处，与 ru 相同，正文分三类逐条列出：标识符和协议名（`ID` ×24、`API`、`JWKS` 等 34 处）、作为标识符的小写选项和默认值（6 处）、5 个 JSON 示例。
- **repeater-row-properties：** 3 处与 `ID` 重复的叶子被拒绝后，dev 改成带父级的名称（`영역 ID`、`노드 ID`、`에지 ID`），与 de、ja-JP 的做法一致，没有绕开这个检查。
- **门禁（check-runs @ `e56cfa32`）：** 36 个 success，17 个 skipped，0 个失败。dev 在 `e56cfa32` 跑了本地 68 个门，全部退出码 0；platform-objects 1931/1931；`check:app-nav-i18n` 在 11 个语言上通过；重新抽取后生成包逐字节相同，`check-i18n-bundles` 32 个包同步。
- **changeset：** `30512-platform-objects-ko.md`，给 `@objectstack/platform-objects` 记一个 patch。
- **接受的偏差：** plugin-audit 的 ko 标签仍是英文回退。它不在认领的文件面里，和 ru、de 一样。
- **落地条款：** `check-governed-merges --pr 31588`：36 个路径中 0 个命中 governed，+7283/−48，超过 3000 行，属于 Tier H。需要 GOVERNED_APPROVERS（os-zhuang 或 hotlong）批准后才能进队。批准后，席位让卡线程再合一次 `origin/main` 并重跑 i18n 同步门，然后由席位落地。
